title: WorkArena++: Towards Compositional Planning and Reasoning-based Common Knowledge Work Tasks
abstract: WorkArena++ is a novel benchmark for evaluating the planning, problem-solving, and reasoning abilities of web agents in enterprise settings. It consists of 682 tasks that require skills like problem-solving, data-driven decision-making, and memorization. The benchmark is designed to drive advancements in the field and provide a valuable tool for evaluating and improving web agents.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine having a personal assistant that can handle tedious tasks for you, like managing expenses or scheduling meetings. This is the promise of web agents, but current models struggle to perform these tasks. WorkArena++ is a new benchmark that evaluates the abilities of web agents in enterprise settings, with a focus on compositional planning and reasoning.

The benchmark consists of 682 tasks that require skills like problem-solving, data-driven decision-making, and memorization.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
WorkArena++ is built on top of the ServiceNow platform and provides a realistic evaluation environment for task automation in the workplace. The benchmark consists of two levels of difficulty, L2 and L3, which require agents to perform tasks with varying levels of complexity.

For example, in L2, the agent is given detailed instructions on how to complete a task, while in L3, the agent must read and remember instructions from a ticket and a knowledge base article.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
The results of the benchmark show that current web agents struggle to perform tasks in WorkArena++. The success rate of the agents is low, with only GPT-4o and GPT-4o-v achieving some success in memorization tasks.

The results highlight the need for further research and development in the field of web agents to improve their abilities in compositional planning and reasoning.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
The development of web agents that can perform tasks in enterprise settings has the potential to revolutionize the way we work. By automating tedious tasks, web agents can free up human workers to focus on more complex and creative tasks.

WorkArena++ provides a valuable tool for evaluating and improving web agents, and can help drive advancements in the field.

config.title: The Potential of Web Agents in Enterprise Settings

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
WorkArena++ introduces several key innovations, including the use of compositional planning and reasoning, and the evaluation of web agents in a realistic enterprise setting.

The benchmark also provides a framework for easily expanding the set of tasks through the composition of low-level building blocks, and the possibility of extracting Oracle-based observation-action traces for fine-tuning.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
WorkArena++ is available as an open-source benchmark, and can be used by researchers and developers to evaluate and improve their web agents.

The benchmark can be accessed at https://github.com/ServiceNow/WorkArena.
